qa: What does it cost to teach on Atelier?
Nothing to start. On Starter you keep 70% of each sale; Pro is ₹1,999 a month and you keep 90%. There is no fee for a free course.
Can I teach live and self-paced?
Yes. A course is self-paced lessons; a workshop is a dated class with seats, in your studio or online. Most teachers run both.
When am I paid?
On the 5th of each month, for every sale of the month before, straight to your bank account, with a statement of each sale and refund.
Who owns my course?
You do. You can export your lessons and your learners’ emails at any time, and take them wherever you teach next.
Can my academy have one page?
Yes. An academy page lists every teacher and course of your school, and payouts can be shared between your teachers.
What if a learner asks for a refund?
Courses can be refunded within 14 days if under a third is watched; workshops up to 48 hours before. You see every refund on your statement.

qa: How long do I keep a course?
For life. A course you buy stays in your learning, with every update its teacher makes.
Can I get a refund?
Within 14 days for a course if you have watched under a third of it; for a workshop, up to 48 hours before it starts.
What is Atelier Plus?
Every self-paced course for ₹799 a month, 10% off workshops and certificates. Cancel any month.
Do workshops happen online?
Some do. Each workshop says whether it is in a studio, with its address, or online, with the link sent the day before.
Can my company buy seats?
Yes. Teams gives a company seats to assign, at ₹1,299 a seat a month, with progress reports.
How do I pay?
UPI, any card or net banking. Every price includes GST, and the receipt comes by email.

How do mentor reviews work?
In Portfolio review, Mira reviews your work live, in a group of eight. You book a slot when you buy.
Where is my certificate?
In My learning, under Certificates, once every lesson is marked done.
When does my payout arrive?
On the 5th, for the month before, in the bank account you verified.
Can I move my course from another site?
Yes. Upload your videos, or link them, and import your learners by email.
How do I embed a course?
Paste the atelier-course tag on your site; the docs show each option.
